long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Buenos Aires, Martín Varsavsky left Argentina with his family during the military dictatorship and studied at New York University and Columbia. He earned his first million renovating and reselling a Manhattan building, then founded Viatel, Jazztel and Ya.com. Those telecommunications and internet ventures established his fortune and reputation as a serial company builder.

His operating focus expanded into reproductive health after he co-founded renewable-energy business Eolia. He founded the Prelude fertility-clinic network and Overture Life, then co-founded Gameto, where he is chairman. He leads Certuma, a clinical-artificial-intelligence company, and has taught entrepreneurship at universities in the United States and Spain.

The vessel evidence is used only for identity resolution and does not appear in biographies, wealth classifications or tags.

Public sources establish historical founder exits, a family office, venture funds and current healthcare-company roles, but do not disclose a complete current asset allocation or his exact equity in Certuma, Prelude/Inception, Overture Life or Gameto. Healthcare is selected as the current primary industry because it is the strongest multi-company operating mandate; the classification does not claim that healthcare assets form a majority of his net worth.

The founder-built mechanism is strong: Forbes documents the first property profit, founder investment, operating companies and exits. Varsavsky describes a middle-class upbringing, but no reliable source fully establishes how the first property purchase was financed or whether family resources materially assisted the launch. Broad Self-made is therefore more precise than either starting-position subtype.

Several secondary references expand the name to Martín Varsavsky Waisman or Waisman-Diamond. Those forms may reflect maternal surnames rather than middle names, and no sufficiently strong official source was found for the CRM middle-name field. Only the encoding correction to the established public name Martín Varsavsky is proposed.

Forbes has published substantial features and current wealth reporting about Varsavsky but no qualifying dedicated personal profile, so no Forbes social is proposed. LinkedIn, X and Instagram resolve securely. His long-established personal domain now displays unrelated spam-like multilingual casino posts on its homepage, so it remains a first-party historical source but is not proposed as a Personal Website social.

Private healthcare providers captures the distinct direct-care clinic network; Biotechnology captures sustained reproductive-technology company creation; Angel investor captures a defining practiced role documented over many years. Artificial intelligence is not assigned because Certuma is too new to establish a defining long-term AI mandate under the active contract, and Venture capital is not assigned because it is not the principal wealth-creation industry.
